text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Gain = default's quantile score minus the arm's, on D10's 96,344 half-hours of the scored year, leads 0.5 to 168 hours. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling 12 calendar months. Dashed rule: no change.'
text.tspan: Gain = default's quantile score minus the arm's, on D10's 96,344 half-hours of the scored year, leads 0.5 to
168 hours. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling 12 calendar months. Dashed rule: no change.
